title: Claude Opus 5
summary: Claude Opus 5 is now available in Conductor!
html:
Claude Opus 5 is now available in Conductor!

Opus 5 comes close to the frontier intelligence of Claude Fable 5 at half the price.

New in 0.77.3

  • Claude Opus 5 is now the default model

New in 0.77.4

  • Fixed an issue where agent replies could disappear after sending a follow-up while a turn was still running

New in 0.77.5

  • Fixed an issue where GitHub and Linear connections could not show up in cloud account settings
